name: skills
title_zh: 工程师练手用的仓库内嵌实操课
tagline_zh: 不是收藏夹，是训练场。从真实仓库里拆出任务卡，边读代码边提交，学完 GitHub 上就有记录。
tagline_en: Not a bookmark list, a training ground. Real repos become task cards: read, commit, and leave a trace on GitHub.
why_zh: 它把「看开源项目」变成「做开源项目」：每个技能都对应一个真实仓库的实操步骤，学完即产出，不是看完即忘。
why_en: Turns 'browsing open source' into 'doing open source': each skill maps to hands-on steps in a real repo, so you produce work.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 GitHub 上的工程实践类技能，不含算法、系统设计或面试题。
limit_en: Only covers GitHub-based engineering practice; no algorithms, system design, or interview prep. Needs a GitHub account and basic git. Content.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Hands-on engineering lessons embedded in repos
